Item #1: Material scientists have used a nano-structuring process to make an aluminum alloy as strong as steel.
Item #2: Researchers have developed a technique of determining the colors of pigments by listening to the sound they make. 
Item #3: New research suggests that fear of death increases superstitious thinking.
